headline: Knee-to-chest S swell, biggest early — beat the cross-on wind.
today: Fair-angle S swell pushing near 2.9ft, the most size Matunuck's seen this stretch, but it's short-period and the SW cross-on builds through the day. Dawn is lightest at 5mph, so that's your window. Fish or groveler early before it gets textured. Fun if you're on it first thing.

daysToWatch.note: Waist-to-chest with lighter WNW cross in the morning. Early session before the afternoon SW cross-on.
Small but light winds all day make it glassy. Log the mid-tide if you want a mellow one.
Peaks near 3ft but very short-period and cross-wind. Morning before the W builds is the play.
Dropping and windy with W/WNW cross 14-17mph. Marginal.
